title: revlens example history
description: history/history.json of an example: how to replay the committed snapshots into a real git repository. This one is not an engagement record - it exists because a git repository cannot be committed inside another, so an example ships the text of each revision and the manifest that turns it back into history.

repository.description: Directory name of the seeded repository; defaults to analysis-repo

branch.description: Branch to create; defaults to main

steps.description: One commit each, oldest first. A step directory holds only the files that step changed, at their path inside the repository.

at.description: Author date, ISO 8601 with an offset. Its calendar day is what joins a change log entry to this commit, so it is fixed here rather than taken from the clock.

tag.description: Tag to put on this commit. The baseline carries one, because revlens build --from needs a name that is the same on every machine.
